sources.title: Owner-supplied church and Science High School reference
sources.note: Inspected 2026-10-02. Owner-supplied reference guides relative foliage, open lawns, pedestrian approaches and reserved parking surfaces. Complete mapped buildings and full road/path widths govern fits where image geometry differs. Positions, sizes and heights are undated estimates; parking areas are schematic spaces, not a surveyed bay inventory. No species, construction history or building opening inferred. Reference bitmaps remain ignored evidence.
